name: sb_raven
title: Raven (Stellar Blade)
note: Raven's own moves from Stellar Blade (user 10-18: "把渡鸦加到角色里，动作用游戏内的"): her AnimSequences (Monster/CH_M_NA_53/Animation) exported by the CUE4Parse CLI (tools/sb_anims.py --folder), read onto her own skeleton and turned humanoid by SbAnims, her long sword in her right hand on the holder her clips key (the game's SC_Weapon socket on Bip001 Prop1). Stance: her battle idle; walk / back / run: her cautious walks and her run. Strikes, picked from 18 candidates (tools/motionpacks/sb_raven_candidates.json, out/raven_sword_candidates_sheet.jpg) among the cuts that keep her within 1.4-2 m - her combos' lunges carry her 3-7 m: A the first cut of her slash combo (quick, high), B a low cut of her Beta charge combo, C its front cut, D the rising cut of her moving chain combo (knocks down). The game's travel (on Root) is taken out of the clip and given back by the fight (Move.travel). Her hits, knockdown, lying, get-up, intro, win and specials are in tools/sb/raven.json.
